purpose: Keep conditional GU construction moving backward from admitted physical phenomena while reserving action-first order for native certification.

stages.output: frozen calibration constraints and a distinct held-out family
preparation, intervention, detector, record, probability and no-signalling demands
conditional state composition, event, pairing, quotient and observable interfaces
locality, causal-domain, coherence, decoherence and state-preserving-dynamics requirements
demand-derived field, coefficient, symmetry, domain and variational constraints on candidate actions

reverse_scaffold_search.selection_rule: Select a Big Wave of the strongest compatible unclosed backward edges with the greatest cross-benchmark information gain; never replace it with unconstrained source-action recovery.
reverse_scaffold_search.action_candidate_admission: A candidate action must cite the frozen downstream demands that require its fields, coefficients, symmetries, domain and variational structure.
reverse_scaffold_search.source_authentication: Source evidence may authenticate, correct or reject attribution. It is not a prerequisite for owner-native conditional candidate construction, and a repository construction never becomes source-owned by resemblance.

forward_certification.promotion_rule: Only the forward chain can earn GU-native derivation, prediction, confirmation or export credit. Reverse-only success earns explicitly assumption-capped compatibility or hosting credit.

quantum_calibration_anchors.observed_constraint: Bound composite objects exhibit centre-of-mass matter-wave interference while environmental coupling suppresses accessible coherence without a demonstrated size-triggered classical boundary.
Spacelike-separated measurements on distributed entangled photon pairs violate a Bell inequality while preserving operational no-signalling.

calibration_holdout_firewall.calibration_use: The admitted anchors may constrain candidate construction and kill incompatible interfaces.
calibration_holdout_firewall.forbidden_credit: Reproducing a calibration anchor used to build the candidate is not a prediction or confirmation.
calibration_holdout_firewall.held_out_requirement: Freeze at least one distinct quantitative or structural consequence before scoring a candidate.
calibration_holdout_firewall.import_accounting: Every probability, composition, locality, dynamics or measurement assumption not produced by GU is typed and counted as imported, fitted, forced or assumed.

regression_invariants: Certification order is not work-selection order.
An empty or blocked action root does not block conditional physical-demand construction.
A physical-state or observable certification blocker cannot be reused as a reverse-search eligibility blocker.
Source authentication and owner-native candidate construction remain separate.
No action candidate is selected without backward demand lineage.
Calibration data cannot earn held-out prediction or confirmation credit.
A direction violation reroutes the same Big Wave and never authorizes zero work, scale reduction or maintenance substitution.
